entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: This ain't the exit!? What the hell[n]is this place!?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: We really did hear people screamin'...[n]So we ain't the only ones who got[n]captured!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Shit, this bridge's raised up! Ain't there[n]some way to lower it!?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: What a creepy-ass statue... Is this s'posed[n]to be Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Dammit! How the hell're we supposed[n]to get outta here!?

entries.en: Blondie! Frizzy Hair! Look over here!
